verifiedAgainst.note: Verified: project-scoped MCP servers live in a `.mcp.json` at the project root, checked into version control, in the standardized shape {"mcpServers": {"<name>": {...}}}. A stdio server carries command/args/env; an http server carries type and url. THE FILE FORMAT IS VERIFIED; THE CONTENT MODEL IS NOT VENDOR-SPECIFIED. Brief section 6.3 asks for 'an MCP server manifest' without saying what a document-derived one should contain, so what this target puts inside the verified envelope is our design and is described in vendorFields.

vendorFields.contentModel: One server entry. Its command and args are template scaffolding, declared here and therefore exempt from the traceability gate exactly as a Markdown heading is. Its `env` block is the only unit-derived part: one key per environmentVariable unit, each traceable to the unit and through it to a source locator. Nothing in this file is prose, so the gate runs over derived key/value pairs rather than over segmented sentences.
vendorFields.honestyNote: The server this manifest points at is `markforge serve`, which is Phase 5 and does not exist yet. The manifest is still correct about the environment the documents declare, and a manifest naming an unbuilt server is a promise this repository has made elsewhere too — but it is a promise, and docs/TARGETS.md says so rather than letting the file imply otherwise.
